identificationModule.briefTitle: KL-A167 Injection in Recurrent or Metastatic Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2 Clinical Study To Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of KL-A167 Injection in Patients With Recurrent or Metastatic Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma (NPC)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study is to evaluate the efficacy of KL-A167 injection in subjects with recurrent/metastatic Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma, as measured by Overall Response Rate (ORR) per the Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors RECIST Version 1.1
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: KL167-Ⅱ-05-CTP (NCT03848286) is a single-arm, open-label, multicenter, phase II study of KL-A167 in pts with R/M NPC. Eligible pts were diagnosed with histopathologically confirmed R/M nonkeratinizing NPC and had received ≥ two lines of chemotherapy. Pts received 900 mg KL-A167 every 2 weeks until disease progression, intolerable toxicity, or withdrawal of consent. The primary endpoint was overall response rate (ORR) evaluated by the independent review committee (IRC) according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors Version 1.1.
